component.name: Select
component.description: A labelled dropdown selector for choosing one option from a predefined list. Includes a visible label, a custom chevron indicator, optional placeholder, and an optional error message. Wraps a native <select> element for built-in accessibility and mobile keyboard support.

useWhen: The user must pick exactly one value from a known, finite set of options
The option list is too long for radio buttons (more than 4–5 options)
Mobile usability is a priority — native selects open the platform picker

notFor.case: Using Select for freeform text entry
notFor.because: Select only accepts predefined options; typed input is silently ignored.

notFor.case: Using Select for boolean or two-option choices
notFor.because: Two-option selects are harder to scan than a pair of radio buttons or a Checkbox.
notFor.note: Use Checkbox for a single on/off toggle; use radio inputs for two mutually exclusive choices.
